title: Noise - Recommended Exposure Limits (REL)
description: The NIOSH Recommended Exposure Limit (REL) for occupational noise exposure. The standard 8-hour Time-Weighted Average (TWA) is 85 dBA, with a peak exposure limit of 140 dBA. Exposures at and above 85 dBA are considered hazardous.

components.content: NIOSH Recommended Exposure Limits for Occupational Noise

## Key Information

- **Primary Limit**: 85 dBA as an 8-hour Time-Weighted Average (TWA)
- **Peak Limit**: 140 dBA for continuous, varying, intermittent, or impulsive noise
- **Status**: Exposures at and above 85 dBA are considered hazardous
- **Source**: [National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH)](https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/homepage.html)

## Regulatory Context

The NIOSH REL serves as a recommended guideline for occupational noise exposure. Workers exposed to noise levels at or above 85 dBA for 8 hours should implement hearing protection and noise control measures.
